source: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways (MoRTH) VAHAN 4 Dashboard
data_limitations_disclosure: Official VAHAN open public dashboards publish annual and cumulative vehicle aggregations without continuous daily/weekly telemetry. Advanced time-series methods (e.g. ARIMA, Prophet) require granular monthly series over 60+ periods. ChargeAtlas India therefore uses multi-scenario parametric CAGR compounding, linear regression trends, and exponential models, validated against the 2021-2024 historical trajectory.
